title: Floating panel remains floating when touched by dialog/child windows
line: A floating panel now stops floating when a dialog touches it, even after the dialog's main window is minimized.
explanation: The panel decides whether a window touches it with a TasksModel, which drops every skip-taskbar task, and libtaskmanager marks every transient window (dialogs) as skip-taskbar. So a dialog over the panel only counted indirectly through its parent window: once Kate was minimized, nothing touched the panel and it floated back over the dialog. libtaskmanager gets an IsTransient role (transients that don't ask to be skipped themselves, so Plasma's own applet popups stay out) and a filterTransients property; the panel's model sets it to false.

commits.message:
libtaskmanager: allow keeping transient windows in a filtered model

Transient windows such as dialogs are always filtered out as skip-taskbar
tasks, so models looking for windows in a region cannot see them. Add an
IsTransient role and a filterTransients property to let them through.

BUG: 523220

panel: count dialogs as windows touching the panel

The panel only looked at windows shown in the task manager, so a dialog
touching it was ignored and the panel stayed floating over it once its
parent window was minimized. Let transient windows count too.

BUG: 523220

From d2633da5e8855534ea3fa79c6d2c1c949286b482 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 05:03:12 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] panel: count dialogs as windows touching the panel

The panel only looked at windows shown in the task manager, so a dialog
touching it was ignored and the panel stayed floating over it once its
parent window was minimized. Let transient windows count too.

BUG: 523220
---
 desktoppackage/contents/views/Panel.qml | 1 +
 1 file changed, 1 insertion(+)

diff --git a/desktoppackage/contents/views/Panel.qml b/desktoppackage/contents/views/Panel.qml
index aea1844c5b..a79758d6ab 100644
--- a/desktoppackage/contents/views/Panel.qml
+++ b/desktoppackage/contents/views/Panel.qml
@@ -110,6 +110,7 @@ Item {
         filterByRegion: TaskManager.RegionFilterMode.Intersect
         filterHidden: true
         filterMinimized: true
+        filterTransients: false
 
         screenGeometry: panel.screenGeometry
         activity: activityInfo.currentActivity
--

review.text: Adding an IsTransient role (@since 6.9) and filterTransients property to libtaskmanager while setting filterTransients: false on Panel.qml's visibleWindowsModel cleanly solves the issue in the right layers without breaking existing SkipTaskbar semantics or Task Manager behavior. Excluding windows with state_skiptaskbar from IsTransient ensures Plasma popups like Kickoff stay filtered, and dataChanged notifications and TaskGroupingProxyModel forwarding are wired up properly. Both commits and the before/after verification accurately match the bug and confirm no regressions for Plasma popups or dialog dismissal.

reviews.text: Adding an IsTransient role (@since 6.9) and filterTransients property to libtaskmanager while setting filterTransients: false on Panel.qml's visibleWindowsModel cleanly solves the issue in the right layers without breaking existing SkipTaskbar semantics or Task Manager behavior. Excluding windows with state_skiptaskbar from IsTransient ensures Plasma popups like Kickoff stay filtered, and dataChanged notifications and TaskGroupingProxyModel forwarding are wired up properly. Both commits and the before/after verification accurately match the bug and confirm no regressions for Plasma popups or dialog dismissal.

Real root cause: libtaskmanager folds every transient into SkipTaskbar, so the panel's region model never sees a dialog once its parent is minimized; a narrowly scoped IsTransient role (transient and not self-skip-taskbar) plus an opt-in filterTransients keeps Plasma popups/OSDs out while letting dialogs count, and dataChanged is emitted wherever the transient set or skip state changes. API additions are documented with @since and default to old behaviour, and the Panel.qml change is one line; it should also cover 517721 dodging. Minor evidence nit: the before shots come from a different rig run (kdetest5) than the after shots (kdetest2), and the role name is slightly misleading given its 'only because transient' semantics.
